You see the gap before anyone else and shout the name of the friend who can reach it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible enemy within 5 squares
Duration
Free attacks resolve immediately. The Weak Boon lasts until the start of your next turn or until used.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Choose willing allies that can hear your call. The Weak Boon expires at the start of your next turn. Free attacks never trigger additional free attacks.

Weak
One ally gains 1 Boon to its next attack on that enemy.
Standard
One ally adjacent to it makes a free Basic Melee attack.
Strong
Two distinct adjacent allies each make a free Basic Melee attack.

Each granted Basic Melee attack uses its attacker’s Brawn and Basic Melee outcomes; this card adds no separate roll beyond any roll it explicitly requires.
